gen-gf-funnel-display-switzer: Funnel Display is spaghetti-thin and loud, every stroke the same width. Funnel Display's strength is expressive swagger, while Switzer, a sans with tubular, wire-like letters and a tall waist line, is best at friendly Swiss tidiness.
gen-gf-warnes-poppins: Poppins is sturdy and tall-bodied, with no thick-thin flicker. Warnes stretches out in spacious, bold ink strokes that taper before touching, and Poppins gives them rope-loose curves to rest against, both free of stroke contrast.
gen-gf-grandstander-manrope: Big-voiced and open-lettered, with a tall x-height. Grandstander is best at bold, expressive shouting with short ascenders, while Manrope, a sans-serif, is best at approachable clarity with bright gaps in every curve.
gen-gf-gugi-switzer: Switzer keeps things Swiss and approachable, a sans of tubular, wire-like letters. Switzer handles friendly text, while Gugi brings bold, distinctive shapes whose tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-fira-sans: Snowburst One is cut like a stencil sheet, wide bridges and all. It does bold, expressive display work best, whereas Fira Sans does its best with no thick-thin contrast and a large x-height.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-amulya: Amulya is the modern half, keeping the gaps in its curves generous while Balsamiq Sans holds a constant stencil-cut weight. Balsamiq Sans earns its keep when big and brief, bold and expressive.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-fs-synonym: Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive, its stencil-cut channel of constant weight avoiding any pinched curves. And Synonym, a sans-serif with dependable, generous curves, can sit at a modest size without crowding.
gen-gf-baumans-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans is contemporary and approachable, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Spline Sans would read smoothly down a page, letting Baumans, with its crescent-wrench c, do the commanding.
gen-gf-baumans-outfit: Distinctive from the first glyph, Baumans has a c like a crescent wrench opened wide and strokes uniform throughout. Outfit's cable-like curves, stopping short of closing, keep the page friendly.
gen-gf-bellota-fs-plein: Wiry, wide-mouthed and unapologetically loud, with strokes like drawn wire. Bellota does distinctive, commanding display work best with its far-flung s, while Plein does reliable work with a clear channel into every round letter.
